BOY BOXING "WHITE HOPE".

Never to have been "knocked out" or had blood drawn is the record of Battesea'sBoxing hope, Master J.Peters the champion schoolboy fighter of Gref Britain. Only 13 years old he took to the ring at 10, and has since won 56 contests. His trophies include seventeen medals, 4 silver cups and more clocks and watched than he will ever use. BRITISH "ELLIS ISLAND"!

While the whole world knows Ellis Island, and many people remember the men with shudders and horror, few people know that Great Britain has also seen Ellis Island, an immigration camp maintained by the shipping companies. This so-called Ocean City is situated in the vicinity of Southampton, and the immigrants kept there are not only undesirable immigrants who are to be returned by the Steamship Companies, but are immigrants for America, and other countries, waiting their turn for the ships. They are housed in model bugslows, and feel very happy receiving the best attention. They are medically examined, sanitary inspection very a very strict rule. Children enjoy playing grounds and grown-ups women are doing House and needlework. Children of Russian and Greek as a school are doing.
